heading: Storybook FAQ 📚
subtext: Answers to the questions parents ask most.

faqs.q: What age groups does Kaylan Preschool accept?
faqs.a: We welcome children from 1 to 10 years across Playgroup L0 (2–3y), Nursery L1 (3–4y), Junior KG L3 (4–5y), Senior KG L4 (5–6y), Daycare (1–10y), and After-School Program (4–10y).
A Montessori-inspired approach combined with the structured Kreedo curriculum for Maths, English and holistic development, aligned with NEP 2020.

faqs.q: Do you offer daycare and after-school programs?
faqs.a: Yes! Full-day daycare is available for ages 1 to 10 years from 8:30 AM to 6:30 PM with nutritious warm meals, nap suites, homework support, and enrichment clubs.

faqs.q: How do I book a school tour?
faqs.a: Simply click 'Book a School Tour' or WhatsApp us at +91 96636 30221 — we will schedule a personalized walkthrough at your convenience.
